question: How does the ManagementGroups module publish integration events?
claim: ManagementGroups command handlers publish domain events through IMessageBroker.PublishAsync (called after SaveChangesAsync), using event records defined in ThingsBooksy.Shared.Abstractions/Events/**. The concrete broker (InMemoryMessageBroker) either routes to an outbox (if IOutboxBroker.Enabled) or to an in-process async dispatcher (AsyncDispatcherJob reading from a Channel) or directly to IModuleClient.PublishAsync. Event handlers (IEventHandler<T>) are registered via assembly scanning in ThingsBooksy.Shared.Infrastructure.Events.Extensions.AddEvents, and Resources module implements four such handlers reacting to ManagementGroups events. There is no Availability module under backend/src/Modules (only ManagementGroups, Resources, Users). Resources module currently references IMessageBroker only indirectly via a comment/doc-string in an integration test file, not in production code; no direct usage of IMessageBroker was found in Resources.Core or Resources API/production code. ManagementGroups has a dedicated EventPublishingTests.cs integration test file that asserts event publication indirectly (by polling for the Resources module's read-model side effects), and Resources also has its own GroupReadModelEventHandlerTests.cs asserting the same.
